actions: Merged existing A1 field/geospatial, A2 plot-layer, and A3 provisional surface branches into a new isolated worktree.
Declared geospatial optional extra and documented terrain Field I/O in English and Japanese.
Added English and Japanese offline-capable DEM spatial-spectrum notebooks.
Rejected complex projection data and incompatible active CRS arithmetic; corrected outer half-cell resampling.
Audited #553 and recorded a deliberate decision to defer gsi-dem/geotiff JSON contract entries until Field conformance validators and a geospatial CI gate exist.
Registered FieldDict read adapters for scalar-only terrain formats and fixed explicit GeoTIFF alias dependency guidance (#520).
